Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

It sounds like your sharper customer focus makes lasting commitments more valuable than another short renewal. We value the relationship and want a straightforward agreement built on longer-term certainty and transparent costs. What scope for a price adjustment could we identify together if you shared your cost-breakdown XLSX, including the material and labour elements?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Using your own cost shares (LCI-C 10%, PPI-C2815 65%) and the latest six-month index moves (LCI-C +1.7%, PPI-C2815 +0.6%), your cost increase comes to about +0.6% of the price, not +13.0%. Our recent orders for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 were at 4.29, 4.39 per 1 (po:4500014329-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014467-10). Our demand forecast for Deep groove ball bearing 6306-2Z C3 is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09). That supports a price of about EUR 4.41. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, 90 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position.

We have adopted your proposed 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, allowing us to offer a revised price of €4.94 per unit. Our current offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Please understand that as a strict company policy, we do not provide internal cost breakdowns. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. While we acknowledge your historical purchase prices and volume forecasts, this offer represents our definitive position under these terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH team,

You have set historical comparisons aside and asked for a firm commitment; it sounds like predictable business is what matters most. We want a straightforward renewal that supports long-term planning without revisiting your confidential costing. What room does that commitment create to settle the price?

We confirm a binding volume of 20,000 units per year for 36 months. Labour cost index DE, manufacturing, seasonally and calendar adjusted (quarterly, carried to its three months) changed -0.3% from 2025-10 to 2026-01 (idx:LCI-C@2025-10, idx:LCI-C@2026-01). As calculated from your own cost shares, the cost-justified change is about +0.6%.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.88 per unit, 90 days payment, 36 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with us. As to the index change data you cited, that does not change our position. We have verified the LCI-C index data you cited; however, it does not change our overall cost calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. That remains. While we appreciate your confirmation of the 20,000 units volume, this does not allow for further price concessions on our end. We must therefore maintain our offer at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
